summary: Skeena Resources Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release reporting results of its annual general meeting and management changes. At the AGM on June 22, 2026, shareholders reelected all directors and approved the omnibus incentive plan and auditor reappointment with over 99% support, voting 71.5% of outstanding shares. Separately, Ryan Maloney was appointed VP of Corporate Development, and Justin Himmelright transitions from SVP of External Affairs to Strategic Advisor effective July 1, 2026. This is a routine governance update with minor management transitions; the changes appear planned, not forced. No deal terms or special situation pricing. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; routine corporate housekeeping.
